evals.name: accepted-author
evals.prompt: Write the command scenario for registering Aster under a fixed author ID.
evals.expected_output: Execute and check success and the addressed payload.
assertions: Awaits Execute and checks the successful result.
Awaits ShouldHaveAppendedEvent with the requested ID and expected name.

evals.name: refused-duplicate
evals.prompt: A second registration should be refused. What assertions belong in the backend spec?
evals.expected_output: Check the specific refusal and absence of the new effect.
assertions: Arranges prior history in the scenario that exercises the refusal.
Checks the reason and distinguishes the prior event from a new append.

evals.name: composite-conflict
evals.prompt: Test that two different sources cannot claim the same constrained combination.
evals.expected_output: Exercise the append boundary with one EventScenario.
assertions: Arranges the first claim on one source.
Attempts the conflicting append on another source.
Asserts failure and the named constraint violation.
